import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert the 'StichtagDat' column to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a bar chart to show the top 5 most common breeds
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(5)
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.index, y=top_breeds.values)
plt.title('Top 5 Most Common Breeds')
plt.xlabel('Breed')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to show the distribution of dog ages
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.histplot(data['AlterV10Sort'], bins=10, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Ages')
plt.xlabel('Age (Years)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('breed_age_hist.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a box plot to show the distribution of dog ages by breed
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Rasse1Text', y='AlterV10Sort', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Ages by Breed')
plt.xlabel('Breed')
plt.ylabel('Age (Years)')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('breed_age_box.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between dog age and weight
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='AlterV10Sort', y='AlterVHundNum', data=data)
plt.title('Relationship between Dog Age and Weight')
plt.xlabel('Age (Years)')
plt.ylabel('Weight (kg)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('age_weight_scatter.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
